purpose: Determine the exact stored value types of taxon and in_taxon molecular properties.
query: MATCH (gene:GeneOrGeneProduct) WHERE gene.taxon IS NOT NULL OR gene.in_taxon IS NOT NULL RETURN valueType(gene.taxon) AS taxon_type,valueType(gene.in_taxon) AS in_taxon_type,count(*) AS genes ORDER BY genes DESC
next_action: Normalize only observed explicit identifier representations; never infer organisms from names.

purpose: Inspect bounded raw molecular taxonomy examples and their original node JSON.
query: MATCH (gene:GeneOrGeneProduct) WHERE gene.taxon IS NOT NULL OR gene.in_taxon IS NOT NULL RETURN gene.id AS gene_id,gene.name AS name,gene.taxon AS taxon,gene.in_taxon AS in_taxon,gene.in_taxon_label AS taxon_label,left(gene.raw_json,5000) AS raw_node_json LIMIT 8
next_action: Use the original attribute structure to distinguish identifier fields from display labels and inspect whether provenance is actually present.

purpose: Inspect bounded molecular taxonomy examples within the already documented curated causal target domain.
query: MATCH (:Drug)-[access:MINER_R0004_CURATED_TARGET]->(gene:GeneOrGeneProduct) WHERE access.artifact_id='r0004-curated-causal-target-v1' WITH DISTINCT gene WHERE gene.taxon IS NOT NULL OR gene.in_taxon IS NOT NULL RETURN gene.id AS gene_id,gene.name AS name,gene.taxon AS taxon,gene.in_taxon AS in_taxon,gene.in_taxon_label AS taxon_label,left(gene.raw_json,5000) AS raw_node_json ORDER BY gene_id LIMIT 8
next_action: The artifact is only a documented sampling domain; any eventual rule must rematch all original target predicates, qualifiers, and sources.

purpose: Inspect explicit aliases on disease-causing organism nodes, without constructing external taxonomic mappings.
query: MATCH (organism:OrganismTaxon)-[cause:CAUSES]->(:Disease) WHERE cause.predicate IN $predicates AND (organism.id STARTS WITH 'NCBITaxon:' OR any(alias IN coalesce(organism.equivalent_identifiers,[]) WHERE alias STARTS WITH 'NCBITaxon:')) WITH DISTINCT organism RETURN organism.id AS organism_id,organism.name AS name,organism.equivalent_identifiers AS aliases,left(organism.raw_json,3000) AS raw_node_json ORDER BY organism_id LIMIT 8
next_action: If taxonomy identifiers match molecular annotations, test exact stored canonical or equivalent identifier membership and deduplicate support by organism node.
